topIssues.title: engine_getPayloadV3 hangs indefinitely building the first payload on a custom Jovian-active genesis
topIssues.author: Temm2
topIssues.body:
# op-geth hangs indefinitely building the first payload on a custom Jovian-active genesis

## Summary

`engine_getPayloadV3` never returns for the very first block after genesis on a
fresh, custom (non-Superchain-registry) OP Stack chain with the Jovian hardfork
active at genesis. Confirmed via a direct, unauthenticated-by-op-node JWT call —
not an op-node, networking, or config issue.

## Environment

- `op-geth`: `v1.101702.2` (also reproduced on `v1.101511.1`, which additionally
  panics with `invalid eip-1559 params in extradata` before even reaching this
  hang — see "Also observed" below)
- `op-node`: `v1.13.5`
- `op-deployer`: `v0.7.1` (`75254822-2026-05-27T13:58:19Z`)
- L1 (settlement layer): a local Anvil fork of Base Sepolia (chain 84532), pinned
  to a specific block
- Deployment: `op-deployer init --intent-type custom` → `apply` → `inspect genesis`
  / `inspect rollup`, run against the Anvil fork's RPC
- Fork schedule: all forks through **Jovian** active at genesis (confirmed via
  `op-deployer inspect deploy-config`: `l2GenesisJovianTimeOffset: "0x0"`). This
  op-deployer version's `custom` intent type does not expose an option to genesis
  without Jovian.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Deploy a fresh superchain root (OPCM, `OptimismPortal2`, `SystemConfig`,
   `DisputeGameFactory`, etc.) onto an Anvil fork of Base Sepolia via
   `op-deployer apply` with a `custom`-type intent.
2. `op-deployer inspect genesis` / `inspect rollup` to generate `genesis.json`
   and `rollup.json` for the new L2.
3. `geth init` op-geth's datadir with the generated genesis, then start op-geth
   with `--syncmode=full --gcmode=full --nodiscover --maxpeers=0`.
4. Start op-node pointed at the Anvil L1 and at op-geth, with
   `--sequencer.enabled=true --l1.beacon.ignore=true` (no real L1 beacon exists
   for a Base-settled chain — see note below).
5. op-node correctly reaches "Engine reset confirmed, sequencer may continue" and
   begins sequencing — `engine_forkchoiceUpdatedV3` succeeds and returns a
   payload ID.
6. `engine_getPayloadV3` for that payload ID never returns.

## Expected behavior

The first payload — genesis has ~2,372 preinstalled accounts (MultiCall3,
Create2Deployer, Safe singletons, Permit2, ERC-4337 EntryPoints, etc.) but no
user transactions — builds and is retrievable within a normal timeframe (single-
digit seconds at most, matching every other OP Stack devnet setup with a
comparable preinstall count).

## Actual behavior

`engine_getPayloadV3` hangs indefinitely. Confirmed multiple ways, ruling out
everything upstream of op-geth itself:

- **Not a networking/op-node issue**: a raw, JWT-signed `curl` directly to
  op-geth's authrpc port (`engine_getPayloadV3`, bypassing op-node entirely)
  times out with **zero response** after 15s.
- **Not resource contention**: `docker stats` shows both op-geth and op-node
  essentially idle (op-geth ~1.7% CPU) throughout.
- **Not op-node's retry behavior interrupting the build**: at `--verbosity=4`,
  op-geth logs `"Payload building already interrupted. id=<id> interrupt=4"` on
  every op-node retry (~12s cadence) — looked like a plausible cause. Tested
  directly: stopped op-node entirely, gave op-geth 30+ *uninterrupted* seconds
  with zero incoming requests, then called `engine_getPayloadV3` manually.
  Still zero response. Rules this out as the actual cause.
- **Not P2P/discovery overhead**: disabled entirely (`--nodiscover --maxpeers=0`),
  no change.
- **Not archive-mode I/O**: reproduced identically on both `--gcmode=archive` and
  `--gcmode=full`.
- **Not a stale/mismatched L1 anchor**: reproduced on a freshly-redeployed,
  internally-consistent genesis/rollup pair anchored to the Anvil fork's actual
  current state.

## Suspected trigger

Jovian is the newest, least-exercised hardfork in this stack, and is active from
block 0 in this reproduction (not activated partway through a running chain,
which is the more commonly-tested path). Unable to isolate further: this
op-deployer version's `custom` intent type has no exposed override to genesis
without Jovian, and no readily-available older op-deployer release predates
Jovian's Sepolia activation (would require building from source to test).

## Also observed (separate, already worked around)

- `op-geth v1.101511.1` panics outright on the same genesis with
  `panic: invalid eip-1559 params in extradata` during payload building —
  upgrading to `v1.101702.2` avoided the panic but not the hang described above.
- Pimlico's bundler (used for an unrelated ERC-4337 gasless-transaction layer in
  the application this devnet supports) doesn't implement the plain
  `eth_maxPriorityFeePerGas` RPC method some tooling defaults to — unrelated to
  this bug, noted only in case it's useful context for anyone reproducing with a
  similar stack.

## Additional context

This devnet's purpose was proving the mechanism for a chain settling to Base as
its L1/DA layer (an "L3 on Base," analogous to how Base itself settles to
Ethereum) rather than to Ethereum directly. `--l1.beacon.ignore=true` was
necessary because Base itself has no beacon-chain API of its own to point
`--l1.beacon` at (it's an execution-layer L2, not a consensus-layer chain) —
worth flagging in case that's an unusual enough setup to matter for
reproduction, though the hang itself appears unrelated to the beacon flag (the
engine API call fails identically regardless).
